language.name: C
language.description: A systems programming language for directly managing pointers and memory

sources: Stanford CS Education: Pointers and Memory (Nick Parlante)
ACM: Identifying Student Misconceptions of Programming
keyInsights: Pointers should be taught after fundamentals (variables, memory model)
Two-Level concept: both the pointer and the pointee must be allocated
MMR (Memory Model, References, Pointers) is the most common area of misconception
Providing code + memory visualization simultaneously is effective
